section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section discusses the potential of active learning for learner-centered training design, noting that previous research has been fragmented. The article aims to synthesize this work by focusing on core training design elements, their interaction with individual differences, and self-regulatory processes affecting learning, performance, and adaptability. The authors believe this approach will advance theory and research in learner-centered design.
